items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: we had Veshaix and started from going out there to play

ctx.x: Right, yeah, salary. That's all. Is Millenburg and Spanish Port and the West End changed much? Oh, yeah.

Oh, yeah. Whew. See, I never saw them. Well, wine and water, you wouldn't know that place out there. Now, they used to have a dummy. They used to run from Decatur and the Lillusion Field. They used to have a little house there at the corner. Yeah. And that was the headquarters. Now that dummy would leave there, and she'd get loaded, and go on out to the Millenburg. See? Right on out to Millenburg. And that's where we had Veshaix and started from going out there to play, went through picnics and things out there…
What about, uh, Tranchinas and, and the, uh, Tokyo Gardens and all those places in Spanish Fork? Were you ever out there?
